about: Wrap rules W1-W3 of 04-crypto.md section 6.3 against the final state of the main log of log.json and, for admins without explicit workgroup access (ADR-058), the edge log of log-rotation.json; cred wraps, and catch-up plans (section 5.11), also for the credential key of an organization (devices only, KM-35). See README.md, 'Log vectors'.
